description: This file defines the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which models a JSON-RPC response message. It includes member functions for accessing response ID, result, error, and validation status.
external_methods: // Constructor and possibly other inherited methods

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message, providing methods to access response data and status.

methods.name: ~Response
methods.description: Default destructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier associated with the response.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result JSON object if present.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response contains an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error JSON object if present.
